title: AI doesn't know its next word
hook: AI doesn't know its next word

beats.say: Here's something wild. An AI has no idea what it's going to say next.
Every word is a bet. The model scores every possible next token,
picks one, adds it, then does the whole thing again. Word. By. Word.
A setting called temperature decides how adventurous those picks are.
It's also why AI hallucinates. A confident guess is still a guess.
So when facts matter, hand it a source to read instead of asking it to remember.

caption: Language models write one token at a time. At every step they score every possible next token, pick one, append it, and repeat. Temperature controls how adventurous the picks are, and it's why a fluent answer can still be a confident guess. When facts matter, give the model a source to read.
